instruction: Pick up the green bottle using the correct arm

source.instruction: Pick up the green bottle using the correct arm

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the LEFT arm grasped the bottle, which was at x = -10 (left half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move left arm toward x=2, y=-14 and rotate to begin aligning with the bottle orientation.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+32, +5, -0) cm, now 13 cm (horizontal) / +16 cm (vertical) from the bottle

frames.state: LEFT fingertips (2, -15, 94) opening 0.95; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Rotate left gripper roll and yaw to match bottle orientation, and descend to z=87.5.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, -0, -7) cm, now 13 cm (horizontal) / +10 cm (vertical) from the bottle

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (2, -15, 87) opening 0.95; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower left gripper to table level (z=77.5) and close gripper to grasp the bottle.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-0, -0, -10) cm, now 13 cm (horizontal) / +0 cm (vertical) from the bottle; closed the gripper (opening 0.69: holding the bottle)

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (2, -15, 78) opening 0.69; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift bottle slightly to z=88 to clear table surface.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, +10) cm, now 13 cm (horizontal) / +0 cm (vertical) from the bottle

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (2, -15, 88) opening 0.70; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift higher to z=95.5 and retract leftward to complete pick up.
